items.title: Textron Unloads a Barely Profitable Industrial Business
items.summary: Textron Industrial has barely grown for five straight years. So Textron will get rid of it.

items.title: Can Special-Mission Aircraft Demand Drive Textron's Growth?
items.summary: TXT expands its global SkyCourier footprint with aero-medical aircraft deliveries in Africa, highlighting growth potential in special-mission aviation.

items.title: Boeing Stock And Aerospace Rivals Facing New Pressure From Brazil Aircraft Tariff Risks
items.summary: Trade war talk is back on center stage, and this time Brazilian aircraft exports, including Embraer, sit closer to the firing line. Fresh US tariff proposals on planes and parts could reshape where airlines and governments source their fleets. That creates both risk and potential openings for competitors. items.title: Can Jet Aviation's Singapore Expansion Support GD's Growth?
items.summary: General Dynamics' Jet Aviation is expanding its Singapore footprint with new hangars and enhanced service capabilities, potentially fueling its aviation services growth.

items.title: Textron finds private equity buyer for industrial business at $1.2B
items.summary: An affiliate of Kingswood Capital Management will oversee the industrial segment, which includes an auto supplier and specialty vehicles. This aligns with Textron’s shift to become a pure-play aerospace and defense company.

items.title: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on Textron Stock?
items.summary: Textron has underperformed the broader market despite strong quarterly results, raised guidance, and a strategic divestiture, while analyst sentiment remains moderately bullish.

items.title: Textron Selling Industrial Segment to Kingswood Capital for $1.2 Billion
items.summary: The signed a definitive sale agreement with an affiliate of Kingswood Capital Management that will see it bring in net cash proceeds of roughly $1.1 billion after tax and transaction-related expenses.

items.title: GE Aerospace Faces Cost Inflation: A Threat to Margin Growth?
items.summary: GE is expanding manufacturing and MRO capacity to capture rising demand, but escalating costs are putting pressure on margins and profitability.
